analyzed_vuln.description: Use-after-free is caused by xmlTextReader freeing attribute names/structures during streaming cleanup while validation still keeps references to those xmlAttr objects in the document ref table. xmlTextReaderFreeProp/xmlTextReaderFreeNodeList release cur->name (and often the attribute object), but IDREF validation later in xmlValidateDocumentFinal->xmlValidateRef dereferences ref->attr->name for error reporting, yielding UAF.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Triggered in xmlTextReader incremental parsing mode with DTD validation enabled (as in fuzz/xml harness) when an element with IDREF/IDREFS (or unresolved ref) is parsed and its node/attributes are reclaimed early by xmlTextReaderRead cleanup (preserves==0 path). At end-of-document, xmlSAX2EndDocument calls xmlValidateDocumentFinal, which walks stored refs and accesses stale ref->attr pointers/names from already-freed attributes, causing heap-use-after-free.
